Allergen practice

Yogurt semolina

Joghurtos búzadara

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 1 portion

This is a milk and gluten practice food. Put fruit and an iron food, such as meat, lentils, or fortified infant cereal, beside it. Try the first taste in the morning on a well day, and once tolerated keep offering milk and gluten a few times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 20 g wheat semolina (a real gluten portion)
  • 120 ml water (cook the grain in water, not in sweetened milk)
  • 3 tbsp plain pasteurized yogurt (stirred in off the boil; no sugar)

Allergens

milkgluten

Method

  1. Boil the water and whisk in the semolina.
  2. Cook, stirring, until thick and the grain is soft.
  3. Cool until just warm.
  4. Stir in the plain yogurt.
  5. Serve beside fruit and an iron-rich food, not as the only dish.

Sound idea

Semolina stirred with yogurt is low in iron, so it cannot be the whole meal.

Cook semolina in water and stir in plain yogurt, with no sugar. Serve it as a milk and gluten practice food beside fruit and an iron food.
